```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)

con = DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "data/midwest_airbnb_extended.db")
listings     = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "listings") |> tibble::as_tibble()
availability = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "availability_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
reviews      = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "reviews_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
```

```{r}
### ## Task 1: Who owns the market?

# Count listings per host_id
host_counts <- listings |> 
  dplyr::group_by(host_id) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(n_listings = dplyr::n())

# A1: Count hosts with 10 or more listings
a1_ans <- host_counts |> 
  dplyr::filter(n_listings >= 10) |> 
  dplyr::n_distinct()
a1_ans

# Join back to listings to find Chicago percentage (A2)
listings_with_host_counts <- listings |> 
  dplyr::left_join(host_counts, by = "host_id")

a2_ans <- listings_with_host_counts |> 
  dplyr::filter(city == "Chicago") |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    pct_large_host = 100 * mean(n_listings >= 10)
  )
round(a2_ans$pct_large_host, 1)
```

```{r}
task2_summary <- listings |> 
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    accommodates >= 4,
    number_of_reviews >= 10,
    review_scores_rating >= 4.8
  ) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(price_per_person = price / accommodates) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city, neighbourhood) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    count = dplyr::n(),
    median_price_pp = median(price_per_person, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  dplyr::filter(count >= 20)

# A3: Columbus neighbourhood with lowest median price per person
task2_summary |> 
  dplyr::filter(city == "Columbus") |> 
  dplyr::slice_min(median_price_pp, n = 1)
```

```{r}
task3_summary <- listings |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city, room_type) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    dplyr::across(
      c(price, reviews_per_month, estimated_revenue_l365d),
      ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# A4: Median estimated revenue for Twin Cities entire homes
task3_summary |> 
  dplyr::filter(city == "Twin Cities", room_type == "Entire home/apt") |> 
  dplyr::pull(estimated_revenue_l365d)
```
  
```{r}
task4_summary <- listings |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(estimated_revenue_l365d), .by_group = TRUE) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    rank = dplyr::row_number(),
    cutoff = ceiling(0.10 * dplyr::n()),
    is_top_10 = rank <= cutoff
  ) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    total_rev = sum(estimated_revenue_l365d, na.rm = TRUE),
    top10_rev = sum(estimated_revenue_l365d[is_top_10], na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_top10 = 100 * (top10_rev / total_rev),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# A5: Columbus top 10% revenue share
task4_summary |> 
  dplyr::filter(city == "Columbus") |> 
  dplyr::pull(pct_top10) |> 
  round(1)
```

```{r}
avail_oct <- availability |> 
  dplyr::filter(month == "2026-10")

task5_summary <- listings |> 
  dplyr::filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt") |> 
  dplyr::inner_join(avail_oct, by = "id") |> 
  dplyr::mutate(is_mostly_taken = nights_available < 0.5 * nights_in_month) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    share_mostly_taken = 100 * mean(is_mostly_taken, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# A6 & A7: City with lowest share and its percentage rounded to 1 decimal
task5_summary |> 
  dplyr::slice_min(share_mostly_taken, n = 1)
```

```{r}
reviews_year <- reviews |> 
  dplyr::filter(month >= "2025-07" & month <= "2026-06")

task6_summary <- listings |> 
  dplyr::inner_join(reviews_year, by = "id") |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city, month) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(total_reviews = sum(reviews, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Twin Cities monthly review breakdown
tc_reviews <- task6_summary |> 
  dplyr::filter(city == "Twin Cities")

# A8: Busiest month
busiest <- tc_reviews |> dplyr::slice_max(total_reviews, n = 1)
busiest

# A9: Ratio of busiest to quietest month
quietest <- tc_reviews |> dplyr::slice_min(total_reviews, n = 1)
ratio <- busiest$total_reviews / quietest$total_reviews
round(ratio, 2)
```

```{r}
task7_summary <- listings |> 
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    !is.na(host_is_superhost),
    host_is_superhost %in% c("t", "f")
  ) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city, host_is_superhost) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    median_price = median(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_rating = median(review_scores_rating, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = host_is_superhost, 
    values_from = c(median_price, median_rating)
  ) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    price_premium = median_price_t - median_price_f
  )

task7_summary
```

```{r}
# A10: Count listings with no rows in availability
missing_avail <- listings |> 
  dplyr::anti_join(availability, by = "id")

dplyr::count(missing_avail)
```


```{r}
## Question 11
listings |> 
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    !is.na(host_is_superhost),
    host_is_superhost %in% c("t", "f")
  ) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city, host_is_superhost) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(med_price = median(price, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |> 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = host_is_superhost, values_from = med_price) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(premium = t - f)
```

```{r}
# A2 Shares across all cities
a2_all <- listings |> 
  dplyr::left_join(
    listings |> 
      dplyr::group_by(host_id) |> 
      dplyr::summarize(n_listings = dplyr::n()),
    by = "host_id"
  ) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(a2_share = round(100 * mean(n_listings >= 10), 1))

# A5 Shares across all cities
a5_all <- listings |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(estimated_revenue_l365d), .by_group = TRUE) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    rank = dplyr::row_number(),
    cutoff = ceiling(0.10 * dplyr::n()),
    is_top_10 = rank <= cutoff
  ) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    a5_share = round(100 * (sum(estimated_revenue_l365d[is_top_10], na.rm = TRUE) / sum(estimated_revenue_l365d, na.rm = TRUE)), 1)
  )

dplyr::left_join(a2_all, a5_all, by = "city")
```
